reading.title: Choosing a career
paragraphs: Choosing a career is one of the most important decisions in your life. Although some jobs are demanding, they can be very rewarding. A surgeon, for example, works long hours and makes difficult decisions, so he or she must be decisive and knowledgeable. Software engineering is popular among young people since the job is well-paid.

Some jobs are so repetitive that workers get bored. An assembly worker, for instance, does the same task all day. However, vocational training is such a useful path that many students choose it after secondary school. Whether you become a mechanic, a cashier or a tailor who sews fabric, you should follow your interests. Although parents may give advice, the final choice is yours.

theory.content: Unit 12 nói về lựa chọn nghề nghiệp. Ngữ pháp trọng tâm: mệnh đề trạng ngữ chỉ sự nhượng bộ, kết quả và lý do (adverbial clauses of concession, result and reason).
1. Nhượng bộ (concession): although, though, even though + mệnh đề, diễn tả hai ý trái ngược nhau. Không dùng but cùng với although trong cùng câu.
Although / Though / Even though + S + V, S + V      Ví dụ: Although the job is demanding, it is rewarding.
2. Kết quả (result): so + mệnh đề; so + adj / adv + that; such + (a / an) + adj + noun + that.
She worked so hard that she passed the exam.      It was such a hard job that he quit.
3. Lý do (reason): because, since, as + mệnh đề; because of + danh từ / V-ing. Because nhấn mạnh lý do mới; since và as dùng khi lý do đã rõ.
I chose engineering because it is well-paid.      Since / As she loves animals, she wants to be a vet.      because of her passion / because of being tired
4. Phân biệt although với despite / in spite of: although + mệnh đề; despite / in spite of + danh từ hoặc V-ing. Ví dụ: Although it was raining, we went out. = Despite the rain, we went out.
5. Từ vựng nghề nghiệp và tính cách: surgeon, mechanic, cashier, software engineer; decisive, inquiring, knowledgeable; demanding, repetitive, rewarding, well-paid.

items.explain: Such + a / an + adj + noun + that.

wrong_explain.1: So không đi với a + danh từ.

items.explain: Though diễn tả sự nhượng bộ.

Từ nào KHÔNG phải một nghề nghiệp?
items.explain: Decisive là tính từ nghĩa là quyết đoán.

wrong_explain.2: Surgeon là bác sĩ phẫu thuật.

items.stem: ____ the rain, we went out for a walk.
He studied so hard ____ he passed the exam easily.

wrong_explain.2: Because không đi sau so + adv theo cấu trúc này.

choices: Although it was raining, we went out.
Because of the heavy traffic, he was late.
Although he was tired, but he continued working.
She was so tired that she went to bed early.

Câu nào có nghĩa gần với “Although she is young, she is very experienced.”?

Despite she is young, she is very experienced.
Because she is young, she is very experienced.
In spite she is young, she is very experienced.

wrong_explain.2: Because chỉ lý do, đổi nghĩa.

Despite it was late, we went home.
items.explain: As + mệnh đề chỉ lý do.

wrong_explain.2: Không dùng although và so cùng nhau.
wrong_explain.3: Despite cần danh từ hoặc V-ing.

writing.prompt: Viết 6–8 câu về nghề em muốn làm trong tương lai và lý do em chọn. Dùng ít nhất một mệnh đề nhượng bộ (although / though), một mệnh đề lý do (because / since / as) và một câu kết quả (so … that / such … that).
checklist: Câu đầu nêu nghề em muốn làm.
Có một câu dùng although hoặc though (không dùng but cùng lúc).
Có một câu dùng because / since / as.
Có một câu dùng so … that hoặc such … that.
Mỗi câu viết hoa chữ đầu và có dấu chấm cuối câu.
sample: In the future, I want to be a software engineer. I chose this career because it is well-paid and creative. Although the job is demanding, it is very rewarding.
I like computers so much that I often write small programs after school. Since my father is also an engineer, he gives me useful advice. It is such an interesting job that I can’t wait to start.
